narration.text: [softly] Eight years. And one night I realised... he hadn't really looked at me in months.
I was angry with myself. Somewhere along the way... I stopped feeling like a woman.
[quietly] I didn't want to see her. So I stopped looking.
It felt silly. It was just lingerie.
But it was the first thing in years I bought... only for me.
The moment I put it on... something came back.
Nobody could see it. But I walked differently.
He came back. But first... I did.

dialogue.speaker: elena
dialogue.line: Beauty isn't for him. You put it on in the morning, for yourself. Then everyone notices.

Restrained, tasteful, arthouse film soundtrack, no drums, no vocals, no electronic elements.
